recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work to replace this temporary extension with a CapabilityStatement2 mechanism should be handled by a new work-group decision or extension-pack/CapabilityStatement2 maintenance, not by changing current core source for FHIR-32674.
issue_request: FHIR-32674 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked for a temporary CapabilityStatement extension allowing servers that support CQL evaluation to advertise supported CQL versions, with string value type, context CapabilityStatement.rest, and cardinality 0..*, pending a later CapabilityStatement2 mechanism.
initial_application: The issue was applied in the R5 cycle by Jira-tagged core commits, including fd379f4320 adding the clinical reasoning extension entry and spreadsheet row, and 272e3fb71e carrying broader generated/source updates with a J#32674 note. The historical row had CapabilityStatement.rest, 0..*, string, and CQL-version wording matching the Jira resolution.
additional_context: Core later removed extension definitions from the R5 source in dd468d4f17 and rewrote clinical reasoning links to use the external extension location in b3e373388f. The current FHIR Extension Pack source defines http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/cqf-supportedCqlVersion with context CapabilityStatement.rest, max *, and value type string, while current core source keeps an OID and clinical reasoning module link to [%extensions-location%]StructureDefinition-cqf-supportedCqlVersion.html. FHIR-40922 later recorded a no-change FHIR-extensions decision that cqf-supportedCqlVersion already exists and other specs are migrating to it.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing an in-core StructureDefinition would conflict with current extension-pack ownership, and the existing extension artifact plus core link already convey the requested capability.

related_jiras.note: Later FHIR-extensions no-change issue confirmed cqf-supportedCqlVersion already exists as the shared/core extension and no additional extension definition was needed.
